description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, a new front porch and erection of an outbuilding in rear garden for use as a summerhouse
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (00, D 01, D 02, D 03, D 04, D 05, D 06, D 07, D 01A, P-01A, P-01, P-02, P-03, P-05, P-06 and P-07- received 28/06/29) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall not be used for purposes other than those specified on the plans hereby approved or such uses which are incidental to the house at [10 Challis Road, TW8 9PR].  For the avoidance of doubt the building shall not be used as a living room, bedroom, kitchen or as a separate unit of accommodation, nor for business purposes.
